title: Validate persisted acceptance replay identity at execution boundary
outcome: Review 7059 Low defence-in-depth proposal. Original actor/context are restored from persisted host-private argv; consider explicit bounded identity validation before spawn. Parent inspection: validate_work_read_target validates binary/path/store, NOT identity, so blindly calling it again would not address this proposal. Define actual identity constraints and malformed persisted-argument tests. No current exploit established; argv-only local trusted persistence. Keep scoped away from confirmed near-limit retry blocker in .16.
